column1: # Known plane C divergences against the EBA Annotated Table Layout 4.2
# Source: DPM 2.0 Access database v4.2 compared with the 4.2 Annotated Table Layouts.
# Criterion: every layout signature must be CONTAINED in one of ours and must not contradict any member.
# Type: 'contradicts' = the layout mentions a dimension with ANOTHER member; 'no-match' = no signature of ours contains it.
# Dated, not pinned: every release is measured again and this list is regenerated.
# CorpusRelease: 4.2 -- this census is evaluated ONLY against a DPM 2.0 output whose cut release
# (mRelease.IsCurrent=1) is this one. Against any other release, C-DPS-01 is marked NOT EVALUATED,
# never expired for comparing tables that are not the same. A future
# plane-c-known-divergences-4.3.tsv declares its own release here, without touching KnownExceptions.cs.
# Nothing else is listed here besides defects of the LAYOUT itself, arbitrated against the Access
# database. The key column of an open table is not listed: the layout draws it as one more grid
# column, but in the destination that key IS the axis, not a cell, so the comparer
# (PlaneCComparer.IsOpenAxisKeyColumnSignature) removes those signatures from the compared
# population beforehand (see C-KEY-01). The remaining entries are layout defects: the .dp sheets
# draw ordinates that the Access does not give to that table.
# F_18.00.a.dp draws columns 0030 and 0055 when the Access gives it exactly four X headers
# (0010, 0020, 0060, 0070); F_02.00.dp draws rows 0440 and 0450 when the Access jumps from 0430
# to 0455. Our output matches the Access. This list is not a census of suspicions: it is a census
# of defects of someone else's artifact that have already been arbitrated.
